s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive abdominal distension with early satiety and urinary urgency
salient_findings: Large midline intraperitoneal cyst compressing adjacent abdominal organs
Cyst measuring 16 × 24 cm on ultrasonography and 30 × 25.6 × 16.8 cm on computed tomography
key_facts: 23-year-old woman
2-year history of progressive abdominal distension
Early satiety
Urinary urgency
No pain, weight loss, or systemic symptoms
Normal menstrual cycles
Mother had a history of ovarian cysts
Abdomen distended with dull percussion notes but without tenderness or guarding
Large midline intraperitoneal cyst on computed tomography
Cyst had a fluid density of 20 Hounsfield units
No calcifications, soft-tissue components, or enhancing septations on computed tomography
Laboratory studies, including tumor markers, were within normal limits
Risk of Malignancy Algorithm (ROMA) score was 4.1 %
Serological testing for Echinococcus granulosus was negative

shortlist.label: Simple ovarian cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Family history of ovarian cysts and large midline intraperitoneal cyst on computed tomography

shortlist.label: Mucinous cystadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Large cyst size and fluid density of 20 Hounsfield units, suggesting a benign etiology

shortlist.label: Serous cystadenoma
shortlist.why_kept: Large cyst size and absence of calcifications, soft-tissue components, or enhancing septations on computed tomography

shortlist.label: Mesenteric cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Location of the cyst in the abdomen and absence of symptoms such as pain or weight loss

shortlist.label: Parovarian cyst
shortlist.why_kept: Location of the cyst near the ovaries and normal menstrual cycles

raw.rationale: The large midline intraperitoneal cyst location and the absence of features suggestive of ovarian origin, such as solid components or septations, along with the mother's history of ovarian cysts not directly implicating the ovaries in this case, support the diagnosis of a mesenteric cyst.

rejected.label: Simple ovarian cyst
rejected.why: The cyst's large size and midline location are not typical for a simple ovarian cyst, which usually involves the ovaries directly.

rejected.label: Mucinous cystadenoma
rejected.why: The absence of septations, solid components, and the low ROMA score argue against a mucinous cystadenoma, which often has a more complex appearance on imaging and may have elevated tumor markers.

rejected.label: Serous cystadenoma
rejected.why: Similar to mucinous cystadenoma, the lack of complexity on imaging and the low risk of malignancy score make serous cystadenoma less likely.

rejected.label: Parovarian cyst
rejected.why: While possible, the large size and midline location of the cyst are less typical for a parovarian cyst, which usually is smaller and located near the ovaries but not involving the broad midline area as described.
